# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "D002 division_by_zero"
description: "/ or % was evaluated with a divisor of 0."
---

A runtime defect: the running program stops with it; no compile phase reports it, and `try` cannot catch it. `sakura explain D002` prints this explanation offline.

`/` or `%` was evaluated with a divisor of `0`. Check the divisor first or refine its type.

Runtime defects come from running programs, so `compiler/tests/ui` has no fixture for them; the explanation above names the repair.
